quotes.text: avoid adding inline JS inside XHTML

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Review-backed and applied in D292093: put new event listeners in JavaScript rather than inline XHTML handlers, so lint can inspect them and the code can manage the listener lifecycle. Existing inline handlers are legacy context, not a pattern to copy.
title: Keep new event handlers in JavaScript modules
